# canvas-rgb developer docs, full text

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs

## Developer docs

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs.md

# Developer docs

canvas-rgb runs on Windows. A daemon drives the lights and the fans and serves a local HTTP API. A separate fan and update service runs as SYSTEM. The tray and the CLI talk to the daemon's API.

The API listens on 127.0.0.1:9430, with every route under /api/v1. A bearer token is checked on each request. Status needs no token; the three preview sockets take it as `?token=` in the URL because a browser cannot set a header on a WebSocket handshake. The Host and Origin headers are checked as well.

The CLI drives the same API from a terminal. It checks who owns port 9430 before it reads the token file or sends a request. `canvas-rgb status` reports what the daemon is doing.

An effect is one HTML file. The runtime reads the head for the name and properties, runs the scripts on QuickJS and draws with a Canvas 2D context. SignalRGB effects use the same format and run as they are when they use the supported calls.

## Start from a task

The getting-started page covers the token and the guards. The reference lists all 68 routes with their request and answer shapes, checked against the route definitions. The CLI page lists the commands and flags. The effects page shows how to write and check a file.

## Before the first request

The token is a bearer secret. Check that port 9430 belongs to the daemon before the token is sent; the getting-started page shows the check for both PowerShell and a shell.

## API getting started

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/getting-started.md

# API getting started

The daemon listens on 127.0.0.1:9430. It binds loopback only. Every route lives under /api/v1. The port is fixed at 9430.

## What the API is for

The editor drives the lights through this API, and so do the CLI and the tray. The routes report the daemon's state and drive the devices, fans, effects and scenes. Other routes read displays and peripherals, change settings, install updates, export or import configuration, run diagnostics, handle first-run onboarding and stop the daemon. The reference gives the request and answer for each route.

## The token

The daemon creates a 256-bit token on first start. It stores 64 lowercase hex characters in a file named `api-token` under the config folder, at `%APPDATA%\canvas-rgb\api-token`. The file is readable only by the calling user and SYSTEM. A client reads that file and sends the value as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

The daemon checks the file's permissions on every start, not only when it first creates it. A file that was copied in, restored from a backup or made by an older build is locked down to the calling user and SYSTEM before the token is handed out, and the token value is never changed. If the permissions cannot be put right, the daemon refuses to start and names the file in its log.

The CLI and the daemon honour `CANVAS_RGB_HOME`. The editor uses the default config folder. With the override set, the CLI and the daemon read the token from the folder it names, and a client that uses the override should look in the same folder.

Two groups of routes take their credential another way. `GET /api/v1/status` is open, so the tray can read it without a token. The three preview routes are WebSockets. A browser cannot set a header on a WebSocket handshake, so they take `?token=<token>` in the query string. The host and origin checks still apply to them. A token in a URL can end up in browser history and server logs, so keep these URLs local to the machine.

## The epoch

The editor page counts its own sessions. Each page load takes the next number, and that number is the page's epoch. The routes that hold something on the lights — the effect draft and the stack preview — take the epoch in the body or in the query string, and the newest page owns what is on the lights. A page that was open before a newer page took over is answered `applied: false`, so an old tab cannot end the draft a newer page started.

An epoch is 16 hexadecimal characters, such as `a1b2c3d4e5f60718`. A route that takes one answers 422 for any other shape. A draft and a preview also carry a sequence number, and a number below the one the route already took is dropped.

## Verify the listener before you send the token

The token is a bearer secret. Whoever holds it can drive the lights and the fans. A local process that binds 9430 before the daemon starts could collect it. Check who owns the port first.

The check finds a process listening on 9430 on either IPv4 or IPv6. Its image must be named `canvas-rgbd.exe`. Its owner SID must equal the current user's SID. The SID check stops a process owned by another user. A program running as you that names itself `canvas-rgbd.exe` still passes this check. The CLI makes the check before it reads the token, on every command that talks to the daemon. `canvas-rgb status` already does it; run that command first if you are unsure.

This PowerShell block does the same check and stops at the first failure. Only after it passes does the token get read and sent:

```powershell
$port = 9430
$me = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
$listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop
if (-not $listeners) { throw "nothing is listening on port $port" }

$pids = $listeners | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique
foreach ($procId in $pids) {
    $proc = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $procId" -ErrorAction Stop
    $image = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($proc.ExecutablePath)
    if ($image -ine 'canvas-rgbd.exe') {
        throw "port $port is held by $image"
    }
    $owner = Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $proc -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop
    if ($owner.ReturnValue -ne 0 -or $owner.Sid -ne $me) {
        throw "port $port is held by a process owned by another user"
    }
}

$homeDir = $env:CANVAS_RGB_HOME
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($homeDir)) { $homeDir = Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'canvas-rgb' }
$token = (Get-Content (Join-Path $homeDir 'api-token')).Trim()
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token" }
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices" -Headers $headers
```

`Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen` returns the IPv4 and the IPv6 listeners. The loop checks every PID it finds, so one listener that fails stops the script.

The same check, in shell form, comes before any token is read or sent. A body request needs `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` as well; without it a route that parses a JSON body answers 415 before reading the body.

```sh
powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command '
  $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
  $me = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().User.Value
  $pids = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9430 -State Listen -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique
  if (-not $pids) { throw "nothing is listening on port 9430" }
  foreach ($procId in $pids) {
    $proc = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $procId" -ErrorAction Stop
    if ([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($proc.ExecutablePath) -ine "canvas-rgbd.exe") { throw "port 9430 is held by another program" }
    $sid = (Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $proc -MethodName GetOwnerSid -ErrorAction Stop).Sid
    if ($sid -ne $me) { throw "port 9430 is held by a process owned by another user" }
  }
' || exit 1
if [ -n "$CANVAS_RGB_HOME" ]; then TOKEN_HOME="$CANVAS_RGB_HOME"; else TOKEN_HOME="$APPDATA/canvas-rgb"; fi
TOKEN=$(cat "$TOKEN_HOME/api-token")
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices
curl -s -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"brightness":80}' http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/output
```

The first request lists the devices. The second sets brightness to 80 on the lights. These requests send the default `Host` of `127.0.0.1:9430` and no `Origin`, so the guards pass.

## The guards on every request

The guard checks every request.

- **Host**: the `Host` header must be `127.0.0.1:9430` or `localhost:9430`. Anything else gets 403 `bad_host`. This is the DNS rebinding guard.
- **Origin**: a request that carries an `Origin` header must name one of the editor's origins: `http://tauri.localhost`, `https://tauri.localhost` or `tauri://localhost`. Anything else gets 403 `forbidden_origin`. The editor sends `Origin: http://tauri.localhost`, which is allowed. The CLI sends none. Preflights are answered for the allowed origins only.
- **Bearer token**: every route except status and the preview sockets needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. A missing or wrong token gets 401 `unauthorized`. The comparison is constant time.

Every guard refusal carries `Cache-Control: no-store`. Allowed origins get CORS headers on their answers and on the refusals.

## Errors

The daemon's own failures use one JSON shape:

```json
{ "error": "validation", "message": "the fan value is below the floor", "line": 3, "column": 12 }
```

`error` is one of `unauthorized`, `forbidden_origin`, `bad_host`, `not_found`, `validation`, `service_unavailable`, `conflict`, `gone` or `internal`. A `gone` answer is HTTP 410 and means an audio test lease is unknown or expired. `line` and `column` appear only when a script runtime gave a position. A `service_unavailable` answer can carry `Retry-After` in seconds. The `error` field gives the reason; the HTTP code gives the class.

Some failures never reach that code. A route that parses its body as a JSON object answers 415 when `Content-Type: application/json` is missing or wrong, 400 when the JSON is malformed, and 422 when it does not fit the request shape. Those answers are plain text with no `error` field. An oversized body on such a route gets a plain-text 413.

A route that reads its body as bytes uses the daemon's JSON error shape for both failures. A body it cannot parse gets 422 with `error` set to `validation` and the reason in `message`. An oversized body gets 413 in the same shape, with the byte limit named in the message. An unknown path gets 404 and a known path with the wrong method gets 405; both come from the HTTP layer. Check the HTTP status and the body before assuming the JSON shape.

# API reference

## Start here

The daemon listens on 127.0.0.1:9430. It binds loopback only. Every route lives under /api/v1. The port is fixed at 9430.
The editor drives the lights through this API, and so do the CLI and the tray. The routes report the daemon's state and drive the devices, fans, effects and scenes. Other routes read displays and peripherals, change settings, install updates, export or import configuration, run diagnostics, handle first-run onboarding and stop the daemon. The reference gives the request and answer for each route.

## About

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/about.md

# About

Method and path: GET /api/v1/about.

Area: Status and output.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/about**

Reports the app version, build, Windows edition, service version and how the previous run ended.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/about"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/about", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `About`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `string` | The daemon's version (`CARGO_PKG_VERSION`), the same as `version` |
| `commit` | `string or null` | The short commit the daemon was built from, when the build knew it Optional. |
| `build_date` | `string or null` | The build date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, when the build knew it Optional. |
| `os` | `string or null` | Windows edition and build, for example `Windows 11 Home 10.0.26300`, when it could be read Optional. |
| `service_version` | `string or null` | The service's version from its `Hello`, when the service is connected Optional. |
| `last_exit` | `LastExit` | How the previous run ended |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/about` | none | About |
| GET `/api/v1/about/report` | none | AboutReport |
| GET `/api/v1/output` | none | OutputState |
| PATCH `/api/v1/output` | PatchOutput | OutputState |
| POST `/api/v1/quit` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/status` | none | Status |

## Example

**GET**

Reports the app version, build, Windows edition, service version and how the previous run ended.

This route takes no request body.

## About report

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/about-report.md

# About report

Method and path: GET /api/v1/about/report.

Area: Status and output.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/about/report**

Returns the scrubbed support report the editor shows and copies, with the fields the bug report template fills.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/about/report"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/about/report", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `AboutReport`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | `string` | The whole report as GitHub Markdown: what the preview shows and Copy puts on the clipboard |
| `version` | `string` | The bug template's `version` field |
| `windows` | `string` | The bug template's `windows` field |
| `hardware` | `string` | The bug template's `hardware` field: one line per device, model-level only |
| `other_rgb_apps` | `string` | The bug template's `other-rgb-apps` field |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/about` | none | About |
| GET `/api/v1/about/report` | none | AboutReport |
| GET `/api/v1/output` | none | OutputState |
| PATCH `/api/v1/output` | PatchOutput | OutputState |
| POST `/api/v1/quit` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/status` | none | Status |

## Example

**GET**

Returns the scrubbed support report the editor shows and copies, with the fields the bug report template fills.

This route takes no request body.

## Output

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/output.md

# Output

Method and path: GET / PATCH /api/v1/output.

Area: Status and output.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/output**

Reports the current power state, brightness and warmth of the lighting output.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/output"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/output", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PATCH /api/v1/output**

Changes the power state, brightness or warmth of the lighting output.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"power":"running","brightness":80,"warmth":6500}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/output"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/output", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"power":"running","brightness":80,"warmth":6500}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `OutputState`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `warmth` | `number` | The warmth of the output in kelvin, from 1800 to 6500; 6500 leaves the picture unchanged. |

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `PatchOutput`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `power` | `Power or null` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. A field left out is unchanged. Optional. |
| `brightness` | `number or null` | The brightness to set, from 0 to 100. A field left out is unchanged. Optional. |
| `warmth` | `number or null` | The warmth to set, in kelvin from 1800 to 6500. A value outside that range answers 422. A field left out is unchanged. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `OutputState`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `warmth` | `number` | The warmth of the output in kelvin, from 1800 to 6500; 6500 leaves the picture unchanged. |

| Method / path | Body | Answer |

| GET `/api/v1/about/report` | none | AboutReport |
| GET `/api/v1/output` | none | OutputState |

| GET `/api/v1/status` | none | Status |

## Example

**GET**

Reports the current power state, brightness and warmth of the lighting output.

This route takes no request body.

**PATCH**

Changes the power state, brightness or warmth of the lighting output.

```json
{
  "power": "running",
  "brightness": 80,
  "warmth": 6500
}
```

## Quit

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/quit.md

# Quit

Method and path: POST /api/v1/quit.

Area: Status and output.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/quit**

Stops the daemon after applying its exit lighting setting and telling the fan and update service the stop was deliberate.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/quit"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/quit", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the stop request was accepted.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `quitting` | `boolean` | True when the stop request was accepted. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/about` | none | About |
| GET `/api/v1/about/report` | none | AboutReport |
| GET `/api/v1/output` | none | OutputState |
| PATCH `/api/v1/output` | PatchOutput | OutputState |
| POST `/api/v1/quit` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/status` | none | Status |

## Example

**POST**

Stops the daemon after applying its exit lighting setting and telling the fan and update service the stop was deliberate.

This route takes no request body.

## Status

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/status.md

# Status

Method and path: GET /api/v1/status.

Area: Status and output.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/status**

Reports the daemon's version, power state, brightness, frame rate, connected devices, active scene and the links to OpenRGB and to the fan and update service.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/status"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/status", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `Status`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `string` | The version of the daemon. |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `fps_target` | `number` | The frame rate the daemon aims for. |
| `fps_measured` | `number` | The frame rate measured over the last second. |
| `frame_time_ms` | `number` | The time the last frame took, in milliseconds. |
| `frames_rendered` | `number` | How many frames the daemon has rendered since it started. The count stops growing while the loop is parked or paused. |
| `parked` | `boolean` | True when the render loop has nothing to draw for: no device the daemon drives wants frames and no preview client is watching. |
| `devices_connected` | `number` | How many devices are connected. |
| `devices_total` | `number` | How many devices the daemon knows about, connected or not. The editor draws one card per device while the list is on its way, so it needs the total and the connected count. |
| `preview_subscribers` | `number` | How many preview clients are attached. |
| `active_scene` | `SceneRef or null` | The active scene, when one is set. Optional. |
| `active_effects` | `array of string` | The ids of the effects the active scene's groups play, in group order, without repeats. |
| `openrgb` | `LinkState` | The state of the OpenRGB connection. |
| `service` | `LinkState` | The state of the link to the fan and update service. |
| `service_down_ms` | `number or null` | How long the link to the fan and update service has been down, in milliseconds, when it is down. |
| `conflicts` | `array of Conflict` | The conflicts that need attention: SignalRGB is running and will fight canvas-rgb for the devices. The list is empty when SignalRGB is not running. |
| `show_zone_panel` | `boolean` | True shows the editor's dismissible panel for sizing the ARGB headers. |
| `onboarding_complete` | `boolean` | False until the person finishes the first-run onboarding. While it is false the tray opens the window by itself onto the onboarding. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/about` | none | About |
| GET `/api/v1/about/report` | none | AboutReport |
| GET `/api/v1/output` | none | OutputState |
| PATCH `/api/v1/output` | PatchOutput | OutputState |
| POST `/api/v1/quit` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/status` | none | Status |

## Example

**GET**

Reports the daemon's version, power state, brightness, frame rate, connected devices, active scene and the links to OpenRGB and to the fan and update service.

This route takes no request body.

**GET /api/v1/devices**

Lists the devices the daemon knows, with their zones and LED counts.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page

```

```js
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `DevicesResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | `array of DeviceInfo` | The devices the daemon knows, with their zones. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rescan` | `boolean` | True asks the daemon to read the devices again before it answers. The answer carries the list it found. |

## Identify device

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/devices-id-identify.md

# Identify device

Method and path: POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/identify.

Area: Devices and lights.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/identify**

Flashes one target LED so the device holding it can be found in the room. An unknown zone or an LED past the end of the zone answers 422.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"zone":0,"led":0,"stop":false}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/identify"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/identify", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"zone":0,"led":0,"stop":false}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `IdentifyRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zone` | `number` | The zone index to flash, starting at 0. |
| `led` | `number` | The index of the LED to flash. |
| `count` | `number` | How many LEDs to flash from `led`, such as a whole fan. Leave it out for one. Optional. |
| `stop` | `boolean` | True stops the flash. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the flash was started or stopped.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the flash was started or stopped. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the device to flash. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/devices` | none | DevicesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/devices/{id}/identify` | IdentifyRequest | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | WhiteBalance | WhiteBalances |
| DELETE `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |
| PATCH `/api/v1/devices/{id}/zones/{zone}` | PatchZone | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/lights` | none | LightsResponse |
| PATCH `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | LightPatch | LightView |
| DELETE `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | none | LightDeleted |
| POST `/api/v1/lights/flash` | FlashRequest | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

## Example

**POST**

Flashes one target LED so the device holding it can be found in the room. An unknown zone or an LED past the end of the zone answers 422.

```json
{
  "zone": 0,
  "led": 0,
  "stop": false
}
```

## Device white balance

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/devices-id-white-balance.md

# Device white balance

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance.

Area: Devices and lights.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance**

Sets the red, green and blue gains of one device. Every gain must be a number from 0 to 1; any gain outside that range answers 422.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"red":1,"green":1,"blue":1}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/white-balance"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/white-balance", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"red":1,"green":1,"blue":1}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance**

Resets one device's gains to neutral.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/white-balance"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/white-balance", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `WhiteBalance`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `red` | `number` | The red gain, as a multiplier. |
| `green` | `number` | The green gain, as a multiplier. |
| `blue` | `number` | The blue gain, as a multiplier. |

**Answer body**: `WhiteBalances`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | `an object keyed by text, with WhiteBalance values` | The colour gains of each device, by device id. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `WhiteBalances`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `devices` | `an object keyed by text, with WhiteBalance values` | The colour gains of each device, by device id. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the device whose gains are set. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/devices` | none | DevicesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/devices/{id}/identify` | IdentifyRequest | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | WhiteBalance | WhiteBalances |
| DELETE `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

| PATCH `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | LightPatch | LightView |
| DELETE `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | none | LightDeleted |
| POST `/api/v1/lights/flash` | FlashRequest | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

## Example

**PUT**

Sets the red, green and blue gains of one device. Every gain must be a number from 0 to 1; any gain outside that range answers 422.

```json
{
  "red": 1,
  "green": 1,
  "blue": 1
}
```

# Device zone

Method and path: PATCH /api/v1/devices/{id}/zones/{zone}.

Area: Devices and lights.

## Request

**PATCH /api/v1/devices/{id}/zones/{zone}**

Changes the LED count of one zone on a device. An LED count outside the zone's range or a zone that cannot be resized answers 422.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"led_count":512}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/zones/<zone>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/devices/<id>/zones/<zone>", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"led_count":512}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `PatchZone`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `led_count` | `number` | How many LEDs the zone holds. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the zone was resized, with the device and the zone it belongs to.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the zone was resized. |
| `device_id` | `string` | The device the zone belongs to. |
| `zone` | `number` | The zone's index. |
| `led_count` | `number` | The zone's new LED count. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the device whose zone is resized. |
| `zone` | `number` | The index of the zone, starting at 0. |

## Light

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/lights-id.md

# Light

Method and path: PATCH / DELETE /api/v1/lights/{id}.

Area: Devices and lights.

## Request

**PATCH /api/v1/lights/{id}**

Changes one light's name, arrangement or other saved settings. A name that is empty or longer than the group name limit answers 422; clear a name with null instead.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Front fans","arrangement":"ring"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/<id>", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"name":"Front fans","arrangement":"ring"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/lights/{id}**

Removes a leftover light from an older configuration; a light on a device the daemon drives answers 409.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/<id>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `LightPatch`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string or null` | The name to give the light. Optional. |
| `arrangement` | `Arrangement` | How the LEDs are laid out, such as `ring` or `strip`. Optional. |
| `reversed` | `boolean` | True walks the LEDs the other way. Optional. |
| `kind` | `ChainPartKind` | What the part is. Setting it sets `arrangement` from it; setting `arrangement` alone leaves `kind` as it was. Optional. |
| `first_led` | `number` | Which LED of the run is the first one. 0 starts the run at the first LED. It must be below the light's LED count. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `LightView`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | `Light` | The light itself, with its id, device, zone and run of LEDs. |
| `led_count` | `number` | The LEDs the light has now: its run clamped to the zone, or the zone's count. |
| `connected` | `boolean` | True when the light's device is attached right now. |
| `label` | `string` | The name the person gave the light, or the device and zone name. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `LightDeleted`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the light was removed. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the light that was removed. |
| `emptied_groups` | `array of EmptiedGroup` | The groups the light was the last member of; each was dropped with it. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the light the route names. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/devices` | none | DevicesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/devices/{id}/identify` | IdentifyRequest | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | WhiteBalance | WhiteBalances |
| DELETE `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

| PATCH `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | LightPatch | LightView |
| DELETE `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | none | LightDeleted |
| POST `/api/v1/lights/flash` | FlashRequest | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

## Flash lights

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/lights-flash.md

# Flash lights

Method and path: POST /api/v1/lights/flash.

Area: Devices and lights.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/lights/flash**

Flashes the named lights white and leaves every other LED dark.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"lights":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"stop":false}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/flash"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/lights/flash", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"lights":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"stop":false}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `FlashRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lights` | `array of string` | The ids of the lights to flash. Optional. |
| `stop` | `boolean` | True stops the flash. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the flash was started or stopped.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the flash was started or stopped. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/devices` | none | DevicesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/devices/{id}/identify` | IdentifyRequest | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | WhiteBalance | WhiteBalances |
| DELETE `/api/v1/devices/{id}/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |
| PATCH `/api/v1/devices/{id}/zones/{zone}` | PatchZone | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/lights` | none | LightsResponse |
| PATCH `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | LightPatch | LightView |
| DELETE `/api/v1/lights/{id}` | none | LightDeleted |
| POST `/api/v1/lights/flash` | FlashRequest | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/white-balance` | none | WhiteBalances |

## Example

**POST**

Flashes the named lights white and leaves every other LED dark.

```json
{
  "lights": [
    "openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"
  ],
  "stop": false
}
```

# Effects

Method and path: GET /api/v1/effects.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/effects**

Lists the effects and saved patterns in the library.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `EffectsResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effects` | `array of EffectSummary` | The effects in the library. |
| `active` | `string or null` | The id of the active effect, or null when none is active. |
| `failed` | `array of FailedEffect` | User effect files in the effects folder that did not load, with the reason why. |

## Effect

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-id.md

# Effect

Method and path: GET / PUT / DELETE /api/v1/effects/{id}.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/effects/{id}**

Returns one effect's details, including its properties and presets.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/effects/{id}**

Saves an effect's property values, user presets and favourite; the effect must already exist.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schema":{"id":"html:demo","name":"Demo","description":"A short demo.","needs":{"screen":false,"audio":false},"properties":[],"presets":[]},"favorite":true,"user_presets":[{"name":"Cold","props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}],"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"schema":{"id":"html:demo","name":"Demo","description":"A short demo.","needs":{"screen":false,"audio":false},"properties":[],"presets":[]},"favorite":true,"user_presets":[{"name":"Cold","props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}],"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/effects/{id}**

Removes one user HTML effect from the library.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>?keep_presets=true"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>?keep_presets=true", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `EffectDetail`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | `PropertySchema` | The effect's property schema. |
| `favorite` | `boolean` | True marks the effect as a favourite. |
| `user_presets` | `array of Preset` | The user's saved presets for this effect. The built-in ones are in the schema. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The values the effect runs with when it is active, or its saved values, or the schema's defaults. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `EffectDetail`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | `PropertySchema` | The effect's property schema. |
| `favorite` | `boolean` | True marks the effect as a favourite. |
| `user_presets` | `array of Preset` | The user's saved presets for this effect. The built-in ones are in the schema. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The values the effect runs with when it is active, or its saved values, or the schema's defaults. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the effect whose values were saved.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the values were saved. |
| `id` | `string` | The effect whose values were saved. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `DeleteEffectResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the effect was deleted. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the effect that was deleted. |
| `presets_removed` | `number` | How many presets went with the effect. |
| `draft_ended` | `DraftEnded` | Set when the delete ended a draft on the lights, so the editor can say the lights fell back. A delete with no draft on the lights leaves it out. Optional. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `keep_presets` | `boolean` | True keeps a removed effect's saved presets in the library, so importing the file again brings them back. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the effect the route names. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/effects` | none | EffectsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | EffectDetail |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | EffectDetail | JSON object |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | DeleteEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/activate` | ActivateEffect | JSON object |
| PATCH `/api/v1/effects/{id}/defaults` | Props | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/favorite` | SetFavorite | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets` | PresetCreate | PresetsResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | PresetReplace | PresetsResponse |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | none | PresetsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/source` | none | EffectSource |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/thumbnail` | none | Binary thumbnail |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/draft` | DraftRequest | DraftStatus |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/import` | ImportEffect | ImportEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/preview` | EffectPreviewRequest | EffectPreviewResponse |

## Example

**GET**

Returns one effect's details, including its properties and presets.

This route takes no request body.

**PUT**

Saves an effect's property values, user presets and favourite; the effect must already exist.

```json
{
  "schema": {
    "id": "html:demo",
    "name": "Demo",
    "description": "A short demo.",
    "needs": {
      "screen": false,
      "audio": false
    },
    "properties": [],
    "presets": []
  },
  "favorite": true,
  "user_presets": [
    {
      "name": "Cold",
      "props": {
        "speed": {
          "type": "number",
          "value": 30
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "props": {
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "value": 30
    }
  }
}
```

**DELETE**

Removes one user HTML effect from the library.

This route takes no request body.

## Activate effect

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-id-activate.md

# Activate effect

Method and path: POST /api/v1/effects/{id}/activate.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/effects/{id}/activate**

Plays an effect on the groups of the active scene, using saved values or a named preset.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}},"preset":null}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/activate"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/activate", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}},"preset":null}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `ActivateEffect`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The values that sit on top of the saved values, the defaults or the preset. Optional. |
| `preset` | `string or null` | The name of a built-in preset or a user preset. A preset's values sit on the defaults, so two presets never leak into each other. Optional. |
| `groups` | `array of string` | The groups of the active scene to play the effect on, by name or id. Leave it out to play it on every group, from the effect's starting values. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the effect that was played and the values it played with.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the effect was activated. |
| `id` | `string` | The effect that was played. |
| `props` | `JSON object` | The property values put on the lights. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the effect to play. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/effects` | none | EffectsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | EffectDetail |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | EffectDetail | JSON object |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | DeleteEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/activate` | ActivateEffect | JSON object |
| PATCH `/api/v1/effects/{id}/defaults` | Props | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/favorite` | SetFavorite | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets` | PresetCreate | PresetsResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | PresetReplace | PresetsResponse |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | none | PresetsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/source` | none | EffectSource |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/thumbnail` | none | Binary thumbnail |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/draft` | DraftRequest | DraftStatus |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/import` | ImportEffect | ImportEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/preview` | EffectPreviewRequest | EffectPreviewResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Plays an effect on the groups of the active scene, using saved values or a named preset.

```json
{
  "props": {
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "value": 30
    }
  },
  "preset": null
}
```


| Path | Type | What it holds |

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Warm","props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/presets"
```

```js
});
```

| POST `/api/v1/effects/import` | ImportEffect | ImportEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/preview` | EffectPreviewRequest | EffectPreviewResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Saves a named preset of an effect's property values.

```json
{
  "name": "Warm",
  "props": {
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "value": 30
    }
  }
}
```

## Effect preset

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-id-presets-name.md

# Effect preset

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}**

Replaces or renames one saved preset.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"rename_to":null,"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":40}},"expected":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/presets/<name>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/presets/<name>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"rename_to":null,"props":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":40}},"expected":{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}**

Deletes one saved preset.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/presets/<name>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/presets/<name>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `PresetReplace`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rename_to` | `string or null` | The new name for the preset; null keeps the name it has. Optional. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the preset saves, by property key. |
| `expected` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the client last saw for this preset. |

**Answer body**: `PresetsResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user_presets` | `array of Preset` | The user's saved presets. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `PresetsResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user_presets` | `array of Preset` | The user's saved presets. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the effect the preset belongs to. |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the saved preset to change. |

## Effect thumbnail

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-id-thumbnail.md

# Effect thumbnail

Method and path: GET /api/v1/effects/{id}/thumbnail.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/effects/{id}/thumbnail**

Returns the effect's thumbnail as bytes: three 16-bit little-endian counts (width, height, frame count) followed by raw RGB frames, rendered without touching the devices. The answer is sent as application/octet-stream.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/thumbnail"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/<id>/thumbnail", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `Binary thumbnail`.

Binary bytes: three 16-bit little-endian counts (width, height, frame count) followed by raw RGB frames.

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the effect whose tile is rendered. |

## Effect draft

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-draft.md

# Effect draft

Method and path: GET / PUT / DELETE /api/v1/effects/draft.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/effects/draft**

Reports the effect draft playing on the lights and its remaining lease.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/effects/draft**

Starts or renews an effect, stack or pattern draft on the lights.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","props":{}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","props":{}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/effects/draft**

Ends the current effect draft.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft?epoch=a1b2c3d4e5f60718"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/draft?epoch=a1b2c3d4e5f60718", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `DraftStatus`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` | True while a draft is on the lights. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the draft effect, made from `draft:` and the source hash. Optional. |
| `source_hash` | `string` | The hash of the HTML the draft was built from. Optional. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the draft runs with. Empty when no draft runs. |
| `lease_remaining_ms` | `number` | Milliseconds left in the lease; 0 when no draft runs. A PUT renews it. |
| `heartbeat_ms` | `number` | How often a client PUTs to keep the draft alive. |
| `lease_ms` | `number` | How long the draft survives without a PUT. |
| `note` | `string` | A sentence about the ending, when it needs saying: the prior effect could not be restored, so the lights are black. Optional. |
| `applied` | `boolean` | Whether the PUT left a draft on the lights. A stack draft that a newer epoch or sequence superseded answers false, and a DELETE that carries an older epoch answers false and leaves the draft running. Optional. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The epoch that owns a stack draft, when one is running: the editor page's session counter. Optional. |
| `seq` | `number` | The highest sequence accepted for that epoch. Optional. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `DraftRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | `string` | The draft HTML, at most 1 MiB of bytes. A stack draft leaves it out. Optional. |
| `stack` | `Stack` | A whole stack as the draft. It plays on the lights, with its layer settings from this document and its property values under `props`. Optional. |
| `pattern` | `Pattern` | A pattern as the draft. Exactly one of `html`, `stack` and `pattern` is set. A pattern draft needs `epoch` and `seq`, as a stack draft does. Optional. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The page's epoch: the editor page's session counter. A stack draft needs it. Optional. |
| `seq` | `number` | The page's sequence number in that epoch; a dropped PUT answers 200 with applied false. Optional. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the draft runs with. |

**Answer body**: `DraftStatus`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` | True while a draft is on the lights. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the draft effect, made from `draft:` and the source hash. Optional. |
| `source_hash` | `string` | The hash of the HTML the draft was built from. Optional. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the draft runs with. Empty when no draft runs. |
| `lease_remaining_ms` | `number` | Milliseconds left in the lease; 0 when no draft runs. A PUT renews it. |
| `heartbeat_ms` | `number` | How often a client PUTs to keep the draft alive. |
| `lease_ms` | `number` | How long the draft survives without a PUT. |
| `note` | `string` | A sentence about the ending, when it needs saying: the prior effect could not be restored, so the lights are black. Optional. |
| `applied` | `boolean` | Whether the PUT left a draft on the lights. A stack draft that a newer epoch or sequence superseded answers false, and a DELETE that carries an older epoch answers false and leaves the draft running. Optional. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The epoch that owns a stack draft, when one is running: the editor page's session counter. Optional. |
| `seq` | `number` | The highest sequence accepted for that epoch. Optional. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `DraftStatus`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `boolean` | True while a draft is on the lights. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the draft effect, made from `draft:` and the source hash. Optional. |
| `source_hash` | `string` | The hash of the HTML the draft was built from. Optional. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the draft runs with. Empty when no draft runs. |
| `lease_remaining_ms` | `number` | Milliseconds left in the lease; 0 when no draft runs. A PUT renews it. |
| `heartbeat_ms` | `number` | How often a client PUTs to keep the draft alive. |
| `lease_ms` | `number` | How long the draft survives without a PUT. |
| `note` | `string` | A sentence about the ending, when it needs saying: the prior effect could not be restored, so the lights are black. Optional. |
| `applied` | `boolean` | Whether the PUT left a draft on the lights. A stack draft that a newer epoch or sequence superseded answers false, and a DELETE that carries an older epoch answers false and leaves the draft running. Optional. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The epoch that owns a stack draft, when one is running: the editor page's session counter. Optional. |
| `seq` | `number` | The highest sequence accepted for that epoch. Optional. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `epoch` | `string` | The page's epoch: the editor page's session counter. A delete from a page that does not own the draft answers applied false and leaves the draft running. |

## Import effect

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/effects-import.md

# Import effect

Method and path: POST /api/v1/effects/import.

Area: Effects.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/effects/import**

Validates an effect file and installs it in the library.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"file_name":"new-effect.html","html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","replace":false}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/import"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/import", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"file_name":"new-effect.html","html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","replace":false}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `ImportEffect`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file_name` | `string` | The file name to save it as: letters, digits, space, `-`, `_` and `.`, ending in `.html`. No folders. The name is refused when it holds `..`, when it starts or ends with a space or a dot, when the part before the first dot is a name Windows reserves, or when it would carry a built-in effect's id. |
| `html` | `string` | The file's contents, at most 1 MiB of bytes. |
| `replace` | `boolean` | True overwrites a user effect of the same name; without it a file of that name is refused with a conflict. |

**Answer body**: `ImportEffectResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect` | `EffectSummary` | The effect that was imported. |
| `replaced` | `boolean` | True when an existing file was overwritten. |

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","props":{}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/effects/preview"
```

```js

  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"html":"<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>","props":{}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `EffectPreviewRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `html` | `string` | The draft HTML, at most 1 MiB of bytes. |
| `props` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The property values the preview is rendered with. |

**Answer body**: `EffectPreviewResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | `PropertySchema` | The draft's property schema. |
| `source_hash` | `string` | The hash of the exact HTML the preview was rendered from. |
| `errors` | `array of EffectError` | What the runtime reported while the draft was parsed and drawn. A preview with errors still carries the loop, so the last good frame stays drawn. |
| `warnings` | `array of string` | The check's warnings: a picture that does not move, one that is one flat colour, and anything the file declared that the loader ignored. |
| `thumbnail` | `string` | The 64 by 40, 24-frame loop rendered with the editor's property values, as base64. Decoded it is the thumbnail format: three 16-bit little-endian counts (width, height, frame count) followed by the raw RGB frames. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/effects` | none | EffectsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | EffectDetail |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | EffectDetail | JSON object |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}` | none | DeleteEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/activate` | ActivateEffect | JSON object |
| PATCH `/api/v1/effects/{id}/defaults` | Props | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/favorite` | SetFavorite | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets` | PresetCreate | PresetsResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | PresetReplace | PresetsResponse |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/{id}/presets/{name}` | none | PresetsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/source` | none | EffectSource |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/{id}/thumbnail` | none | Binary thumbnail |
| GET `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| PUT `/api/v1/effects/draft` | DraftRequest | DraftStatus |
| DELETE `/api/v1/effects/draft` | none | DraftStatus |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/import` | ImportEffect | ImportEffectResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/effects/preview` | EffectPreviewRequest | EffectPreviewResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Renders a draft HTML effect with the given property values.

```json
{
  "html": "<head><title>Demo</title><meta description=\"A short demo.\" /></head><body><canvas id=\"stage\" width=\"320\" height=\"200\"></canvas></body><script>function draw(){ window.requestAnimationFrame(draw); } window.requestAnimationFrame(draw);</script>",
  "props": {}
}
```

## Pattern

# Pattern

Method and path: GET / PUT / DELETE /api/v1/patterns/{id}.

Area: Stacks and patterns.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/patterns/{id}**

Returns one pattern's frames and transitions.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/patterns/{id}**

Creates or updates a pattern.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"pattern:Example","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#d21e28","#0f9d58","#1a73e8","#fbbc04"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"id":"pattern:Example","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#d21e28","#0f9d58","#1a73e8","#fbbc04"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/patterns/{id}**

Deletes a pattern; one a group plays needs ?force=true, and the answer names the scenes that played it.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>?force=true"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/patterns/<id>?force=true", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `Pattern`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the pattern, made from `pattern:` and the name. A save never renames a pattern, and a body whose id does not match the path is refused. |
| `built_on` | `BuiltOn` | The device shape the pattern was built on. |
| `frames` | `array of Frame` | The frames of the pattern, in order. |
| `motion` | `Motion` | How the frames move: `none` holds the first frame, `spin` turns the pattern along its LEDs at `turns_per_s` laps a second. |
| `playback` | `Playback` | How the frames play. Leave it out to loop. Optional. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `Pattern`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the pattern, made from `pattern:` and the name. A save never renames a pattern, and a body whose id does not match the path is refused. |
| `built_on` | `BuiltOn` | The device shape the pattern was built on. |
| `frames` | `array of Frame` | The frames of the pattern, in order. |
| `motion` | `Motion` | How the frames move: `none` holds the first frame, `spin` turns the pattern along its LEDs at `turns_per_s` laps a second. Optional. |
| `playback` | `Playback` | How the frames play. Leave it out to loop. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `Pattern`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the pattern, made from `pattern:` and the name. A save never renames a pattern, and a body whose id does not match the path is refused. |
| `built_on` | `BuiltOn` | The device shape the pattern was built on. |
| `frames` | `array of Frame` | The frames of the pattern, in order. |
| `motion` | `Motion` | How the frames move: `none` holds the first frame, `spin` turns the pattern along its LEDs at `turns_per_s` laps a second. |
| `playback` | `Playback` | How the frames play. Leave it out to loop. Optional. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `DeletePatternResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the pattern was deleted. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the pattern that was deleted. |
| `favorite_removed` | `boolean` | True when the delete also removed the pattern from the favourites. |
| `note` | `string` | The sentence about the group that went dark, when a group played the pattern: `pattern:Example was deleted while a group played it, so that group is dark`. It is left out when no group played the pattern. Optional. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `force` | `boolean` | True deletes a pattern that a scene still plays. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the pattern the route names. |

| Method / path | Body | Answer |

| PUT `/api/v1/patterns/{id}` | Pattern | Pattern |
| DELETE `/api/v1/patterns/{id}` | none | DeletePatternResponse |

| PUT `/api/v1/stacks/{id}` | Stack | Stack |
| DELETE `/api/v1/stacks/{id}` | none | DeleteStackResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/stacks/preview` | StackPreviewRequest | StackPreviewResponse |
| DELETE `/api/v1/stacks/preview` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**GET**

Returns one pattern's frames and transitions.

This route takes no request body.

**PUT**

Creates or updates a pattern.

```json
{
  "id": "pattern:Example",
  "built_on": {
    "led_count": 4,
    "arrangement": "ring"
  },
  "frames": [
    {
      "colors": [
        "#d21e28",
        "#0f9d58",
        "#1a73e8",
        "#fbbc04"
      ],
      "hold": 0
    }
  ],
  "motion": {
    "type": "none"
  }
}
```

**DELETE**

Deletes a pattern; one a group plays needs ?force=true, and the answer names the scenes that played it.

This route takes no request body.

# Stack

## Request

**GET /api/v1/stacks/{id}**

Returns one stack and the state of each of its layers.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/<id>"
```

```js

  headers: {

  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/stacks/{id}**

Creates or replaces a stack.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"stack:example","layers":[]}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/<id>"
```

```js
  body: JSON.stringify({"id":"stack:example","layers":[]}),
});
```

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/<id>?force=true"
```

```js

  },
});

```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

| `layers` | `array of StackLayerStatus` | The state of each layer of the stack. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `Stack`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the stack, made from `stack:` and the name. The name is the id without the prefix, so there is one string. |
| `layers` | `array of StackLayer` | The layers of the stack, bottom first: the first layer is painted first. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `Stack`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the stack, made from `stack:` and the name. The name is the id without the prefix, so there is one string. |
| `layers` | `array of StackLayer` | The layers of the stack, bottom first: the first layer is painted first. |

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the stack was deleted. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the stack that was deleted. |
| `presets_removed` | `number` | How many presets of the stack went with it. |
| `favorite_removed` | `boolean` | True when the stack was one of the person's favourites. |
| `note` | `string` | Set when the deleted stack was on the lights and they went black. The text says the stack was deleted while a group played it, so that group is dark. Optional. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `force` | `boolean` | True deletes a stack that a scene still plays. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the stack the route names. |

## Stack preview

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/stacks-preview.md

# Stack preview

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/stacks/preview.

Area: Stacks and patterns.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/stacks/preview**

Starts or updates the stack used by the preview engine, for a group id the active scene has.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"stack":{"id":"stack:example","layers":[]},"epoch":"a1b2c3d4e5f60718","seq":1}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/preview?group=everything"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/preview?group=everything", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"stack":{"id":"stack:example","layers":[]},"epoch":"a1b2c3d4e5f60718","seq":1}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/stacks/preview**

Stops the stack preview.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/preview?epoch=a1b2c3d4e5f60718"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/stacks/preview?epoch=a1b2c3d4e5f60718", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `StackPreviewRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stack` | `Stack` | The stack to preview. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The page's epoch: the editor page's session counter. |
| `seq` | `number` | The page's sequence number for this preview: a lower one is dropped. |

**Answer body**: `StackPreviewResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `applied` | `boolean` | False when the PUT was superseded by a newer one, or a newer epoch owns the preview; the answer is a 200 and the page stops resending that change. |
| `epoch` | `string` | The epoch that owns the preview after this PUT: the editor page's session counter. |
| `seq` | `number` | The highest sequence accepted for that epoch. |
| `layers` | `array of StackPreviewLayer` | What each layer of the previewed stack is doing. |
| `running` | `boolean` | True while the stack preview is running. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group` | `string` | The id of a group in the active scene. The default scene's only group has the id everything. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: whether a preview was dropped, and whether the page that sent the epoch owned it.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the request was handled. |
| `running` | `boolean` | True when a preview was dropped by this call. |
| `applied` | `boolean` | True when the page that sent the epoch owned the preview. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `epoch` | `string` | The page's epoch: the editor page's session counter. A preview stops only for the page whose epoch matches. |

```json
{
  "stack": {
    "id": "stack:example",
    "layers": []
  },
```
