## Fans

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/fans.md

# Fans

Method and path: GET /api/v1/fans.

Area: Fans.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/fans**

Reports the fan headers, the temperatures and the active profile.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `FansStatus`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chip` | `string or null` | The name of the fan chip, once the fan service has detected it. |
| `hardware_watchdog` | `boolean or null` | Whether the chip has a hardware fan watchdog reachable via PawnIO; null while that is still being settled. |
| `headers` | `array of FanHeaderStatus` | One entry per fan header, with its mode and state. |
| `temps` | `array of TempReading` | The temperature readings the fan service reports. |
| `active_profile` | `string` | The fan profile in force. |
| `profiles` | `array of string` | The names of the profiles the fan service knows. |
| `floor_percent` | `number` | The lowest duty the fan service allows, in percent. |
| `hot` | `array of HotLimitStatus` | The hot line in force per kind of source, for the curve chart. Old payloads without it parse as empty. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/fans` | none | FansStatus |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}` | FanMode | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}/availability` | PutFanHeaderAvailability | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/hot` | HotLimits | FansStatus |
| GET `/api/v1/fans/profile` | none | FanProfileName |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/profile` | FanProfileName | FanProfileName |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | FanProfile | FanProfile |
| DELETE `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**GET**

Reports the fan headers, the temperatures and the active profile.

This route takes no request body.

## Fan header

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/fans-headers-h.md

# Fan header

Method and path: PATCH /api/v1/fans/headers/{h}.

Area: Fans.

## Request

**PATCH /api/v1/fans/headers/{h}**

Changes the mode and settings of one fan header. A percent below the configured floor answers 422: the floor is 20 percent, or 30 for the CPU and GPU headers, and a higher value can be configured. `fixed` needs `percent`, `source` needs its fields, and `curve` needs 2 to 8 `points` sorted by temperature.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"mode":"bios"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/headers/<h>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/headers/<h>", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"mode":"bios"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `FanMode`.

One of: "bios", "fixed", "curve".

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `"bios" or "fixed" or "curve"` | The mode the header runs in: `bios`, `fixed` or `curve`. |
| `percent` | `number` | The duty the header runs at, from 0 to 100. Required for `fixed` and at or above the header's floor. Optional. |
| `source` | `TempSource` | The temperature source a `curve` reads: `cpu`, `gpu` or a named board sensor. Required for `curve`. Optional. |
| `points` | `array of CurvePoint` | The points of a `curve`, 2 to 8, sorted by temperature. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the header whose mode changed and the mode that was set.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the mode was accepted. |
| `header` | `string` | The header whose mode changed. |
| `mode` | `JSON object` | The mode that was set. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `h` | `string` | The id of a fan header, such as cpu_fan. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/fans` | none | FansStatus |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}` | FanMode | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}/availability` | PutFanHeaderAvailability | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/hot` | HotLimits | FansStatus |
| GET `/api/v1/fans/profile` | none | FanProfileName |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/profile` | FanProfileName | FanProfileName |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | FanProfile | FanProfile |
| DELETE `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**PATCH**

Changes the mode and settings of one fan header. A percent below the configured floor answers 422: the floor is 20 percent, or 30 for the CPU and GPU headers, and a higher value can be configured. `fixed` needs `percent`, `source` needs its fields, and `curve` needs 2 to 8 `points` sorted by temperature.

```json
{
  "mode": "bios"
}
```

## Fan header availability

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/fans-headers-h-availability.md

# Fan header availability

Method and path: PUT /api/v1/fans/headers/{h}/availability.

Area: Fans.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/fans/headers/{h}/availability**

Chooses whether the fan service shows one fan header; null leaves the choice to the board's own table.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"available":false}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/headers/<h>/availability"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/headers/<h>/availability", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"available":false}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `PutFanHeaderAvailability`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | `boolean or null` | False hides the header, true shows it anyway, null leaves the board's own table in charge. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields of `FansStatus`, the fan status after the change. When the status cannot be read again, the answer carries the saved status with this header changed; when no status is saved, the answer carries only `ok`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chip` | `string or null` | The fan chip once it is detected. |
| `hardware_watchdog` | `boolean or null` | Whether a hardware watchdog is reachable; null while that is still being settled. |
| `headers` | `array of JSON objects` | One entry per fan header, with its mode and state. |
| `temps` | `array of JSON objects` | The temperature readings the service reports. |
| `active_profile` | `string` | The profile in force. |
| `profiles` | `array of strings` | The profiles the service knows. |
| `floor_percent` | `number` | The lowest duty the service allows. |
| `hot` | `array of JSON objects` | The hot line in force for each source kind. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `h` | `string` | The id of a fan header, such as cpu_fan. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/fans` | none | FansStatus |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}` | FanMode | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/headers/{h}/availability` | PutFanHeaderAvailability | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/hot` | HotLimits | FansStatus |
| GET `/api/v1/fans/profile` | none | FanProfileName |
| PATCH `/api/v1/fans/profile` | FanProfileName | FanProfileName |
| PUT `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | FanProfile | FanProfile |
| DELETE `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**PUT**

Chooses whether the fan service shows one fan header; null leaves the choice to the board's own table.

```json
{
  "available": false
}
```

## Fan hot temperatures

# Fan hot temperatures

Method and path: PUT /api/v1/fans/hot.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/fans/hot**

Sets the temperatures at which fans are driven at full duty.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"cpu_c":75,"gpu_c":null,"board_c":null}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/hot"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/hot", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"cpu_c":75,"gpu_c":null,"board_c":null}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `HotLimits`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cpu_c` | `number or null` | The CPU temperature for the hot limit, in degrees Celsius. Optional. |
| `gpu_c` | `number or null` | The GPU temperature for the hot limit, in degrees Celsius. Optional. |
| `board_c` | `number or null` | The board temperature for the hot limit, in degrees Celsius. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `FansStatus`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `chip` | `string or null` | The name of the fan chip, once the fan service has detected it. |
| `hardware_watchdog` | `boolean or null` | Whether the chip has a hardware fan watchdog reachable via PawnIO; null while that is still being settled. |
| `headers` | `array of FanHeaderStatus` | One entry per fan header, with its mode and state. |
| `temps` | `array of TempReading` | The temperature readings the fan service reports. |
| `active_profile` | `string` | The fan profile in force. |
| `profiles` | `array of string` | The names of the profiles the fan service knows. |
| `floor_percent` | `number` | The lowest duty the fan service allows, in percent. |
| `hot` | `array of HotLimitStatus` | The hot line in force per kind of source, for the curve chart. Old payloads without it parse as empty. |

| DELETE `/api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}` | none | JSON object |

```json
  "gpu_c": null,
  "board_c": null
```
```json
}
```

## Fan profiles

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/fans-profiles-name.md

# Fan profiles

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}.

Area: Fans.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}**

Creates or replaces a named fan profile. A name in the body that differs from the path, or a value below the configured fan floor, answers 422.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Default","headers":{}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/profiles/<name>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/profiles/<name>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"name":"Default","headers":{}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/fans/profiles/{name}**

Deletes a named fan profile.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/profiles/<name>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/fans/profiles/<name>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `FanProfile`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the fan profile. |
| `headers` | `an object keyed by text, with FanMode values` | The mode of each fan header, by header id. Headers that are not listed stay on BIOS. |

**Answer body**: `FanProfile`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the fan profile. |
| `headers` | `an object keyed by text, with FanMode values` | The mode of each fan header, by header id. Headers that are not listed stay on BIOS. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the profile that was deleted.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the profile was deleted. |
| `name` | `string` | The profile that was deleted. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the fan profile to change. |

## Header setup

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/chains-device-zone-setup.md

# Header setup

Method and path: POST / DELETE /api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup.

Area: Scenes and chains.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup**

Starts a setup session for one header.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup"
# The answer carries the session id. The setup requests that follow send it in their body.
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup**

Ends a header setup, restoring the earlier length and the scene.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"session":"setup-7f3a91c2"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup"
# Send the session id the setup POST answered with.
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"session":"setup-7f3a91c2"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `SetupStarted`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `string` | The id the setup answered with. |
| `restore_to` | `number` | The length the header goes back to if the setup ends without a commit. |
| `raised_to` | `number` | The length the header was raised to: the zone's maximum. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `SetupEmpty`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `string` | The id the setup answered with. |

The fields the daemon sends: the setup ended and the header's length after the restore.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the setup ended. |
| `leds` | `number` | The header's length after the restore. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `string` | The id of the device the route names. |
| `zone` | `number` | The index of the zone, starting at 0. |

## Setup commit

# Setup commit

## Request

**POST /api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/commit**

Applies the chosen zone sizes to a header and saves them.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"session":"setup-7f3a91c2","parts":[{"name":"Fan run","kind":"fan","leds":12}]}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup/commit"
# Send the session id the setup POST answered with.
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/chains/<device>/<zone>/setup/commit", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"session":"setup-7f3a91c2","parts":[{"name":"Fan run","kind":"fan","leds":12}]}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `SetupCommit`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `string` | The id the setup answered with. |
| `parts` | `array of SetupPart` | The parts in chain order; their LED counts add up to the final length. |

**Answer body**: `SetupCommitted`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lights` | `array of LightView` | The lights the setup made, with what the editor shows for each. |
| `final_leds` | `number` | The header's final LED count. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `string` | The id of the device the route names. |
| `zone` | `number` | The index of the zone, starting at 0. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/chains` | none | ChainsResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | none | SetupStarted |
| DELETE `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/commit` | SetupCommit | SetupCommitted |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/empty` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/light` | SetupLight | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/scenes` | none | ScenesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes` | SceneCreate | SceneAnswer |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes` | ScenesWrite | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | ScenePut | SceneAnswer |
| DELETE `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | none | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/brightness` | GroupBrightnessPut | Scene |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/move` | GroupMove | GroupMoved |
| PATCH `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/props` | Props | Scene |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/active` | SceneActivePut | ScenesResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Applies the chosen zone sizes to a header and saves them.

```json
{
  "session": "setup-7f3a91c2",
  "parts": [
    {
      "name": "Fan run",
      "kind": "fan",
      "leds": 12
    }
  ]
}
```

## Scenes

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/scenes.md

# Scenes

Method and path: GET / POST / PUT /api/v1/scenes.

Area: Scenes and chains.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/scenes**

Lists the scenes and marks the active one.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**POST /api/v1/scenes**

Creates a scene from the groups in the request.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name":"Gaming"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"name":"Gaming"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/scenes**

Writes several scenes or their order in one save.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `ScenesResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `string` | The id of the active scene. |
| `scenes` | `array of Scene` | The saved scenes. |
| `group_states` | `array of GroupState` | The active scene's groups, in its order. |

**POST**

**Request body**: `SceneCreate`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the new scene. |
| `copy_of` | `string` | The id of a scene to copy the groups from. Optional. |
| `groups` | `array of NewGroup` | The groups the new scene holds, in order. The daemon mints each group's id and runs the scene rules before it saves. Optional. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | True runs every check and saves nothing; the answer says saved false. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `SceneAnswer`.

A saved scene object, or a dry-run answer with saved set to false.

**PUT**

**Request body**: `ScenesWrite`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scenes` | `array of SceneWrite` | The scenes to replace whole. Leave them out for an order-only write. Optional. |
| `order` | `array of string` | The new order: every scene id exactly once. The same order as now answers 200 with no write. Optional. |
| `expected_order` | `array of string` | The order the caller last saw; a different current order answers 409 carrying it. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `ScenesResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `string` | The id of the active scene. |
| `scenes` | `array of Scene` | The saved scenes. |
| `group_states` | `array of GroupState` | The active scene's groups, in its order. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/chains` | none | ChainsResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | none | SetupStarted |
| DELETE `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/commit` | SetupCommit | SetupCommitted |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/empty` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/light` | SetupLight | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/scenes` | none | ScenesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes` | SceneCreate | SceneAnswer |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes` | ScenesWrite | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | ScenePut | SceneAnswer |
| DELETE `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | none | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/brightness` | GroupBrightnessPut | Scene |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/move` | GroupMove | GroupMoved |
| PATCH `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/props` | Props | Scene |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/active` | SceneActivePut | ScenesResponse |

## Example

**GET**

Lists the scenes and marks the active one.

This route takes no request body.

**POST**

Creates a scene from the groups in the request.

```json
{
  "name": "Gaming"
}
```

**PUT**

Writes several scenes or their order in one save.

```json
{}
```

## Scene

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/scenes-id.md

# Scene

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/scenes/{id}.

Area: Scenes and chains.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/scenes/{id}**

Replaces one scene and its groups.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"scene":{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","rev":1,"groups":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","members":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"plays":{"type":"effect","effect":"solid","props":{}},"mode":"flow_across","brightness":100}]},"expected_rev":2}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"scene":{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","rev":1,"groups":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","members":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"plays":{"type":"effect","effect":"solid","props":{}},"mode":"flow_across","brightness":100}]},"expected_rev":2}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/scenes/{id}**

Deletes one scene.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `ScenePut`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `scene` | `Scene` | The scene to save. |
| `expected_rev` | `number` | The revision the change was made from. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | True runs every check and saves nothing; the answer says saved false. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `SceneAnswer`.

A saved scene object, or a dry-run answer with saved set to false.

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `ScenesResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | `string` | The id of the active scene. |
| `scenes` | `array of Scene` | The saved scenes. |
| `group_states` | `array of GroupState` | The active scene's groups, in its order. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the scene the route names. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/chains` | none | ChainsResponse |

## Example

**PUT**

Replaces one scene and its groups.

```json
{
  "scene": {
    "id": "everything",
    "name": "Everything",
    "rev": 1,
    "groups": [
      {
        "id": "everything",
        "name": "Everything",
        "members": [
          "openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"
        ],
        "plays": {
          "type": "effect",
          "effect": "solid",
          "props": {}
        },
        "mode": "flow_across",
        "brightness": 100
      }
    ]
  },

```

**DELETE**

## Move group

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/scenes-id-groups-group-move.md

# Move group

Method and path: POST /api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/move.

Area: Scenes and chains.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/move**

Moves or copies one group between two scenes in one save.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"to":"scene:other","copy":true,"expected_rev_from":4,"expected_rev_to":1}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>/groups/<group>/move"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>/groups/<group>/move", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"to":"scene:other","copy":true,"expected_rev_from":4,"expected_rev_to":1}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `GroupMove`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `to` | `string` | The id of the scene the group goes to. |
| `copy` | `boolean` | True copies the group: the source scene keeps the group and its revision, and the copy gets a fresh group id. |
| `expected_rev_from` | `number` | The revision of the source scene the request was made from. |
| `expected_rev_to` | `number` | The revision of the target scene the request was made from. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | True runs every check and saves nothing; the answer says saved false. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `GroupMoved`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group_id` | `string` | The id the group has in the target scene: its own when the target lacks it, else a fresh one; a copy always has a fresh one. |
| `saved` | `boolean` | False for a dry run: nothing was written and the scenes below are what would be. |
| `scenes` | `array of Scene` | The scenes after the move, the source and then the target. A copy leaves the source scene as it was. |
| `before` | `array of Scene` | The scenes before the move, the source and then the target: what an undo writes back. |
| `taken` | `array of GroupTaken` | The lights taken out of the target's other groups. |
| `emptied` | `array of string` | The names of the groups that held no light afterwards and were removed. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the scene that holds the group. |
| `group` | `string` | The id of a group in the scene named by the `id` path parameter. Any scene, active or not. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/chains` | none | ChainsResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | none | SetupStarted |
| DELETE `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/commit` | SetupCommit | SetupCommitted |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/empty` | SetupEmpty | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/chains/{device}/{zone}/setup/light` | SetupLight | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/scenes` | none | ScenesResponse |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes` | SceneCreate | SceneAnswer |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes` | ScenesWrite | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | ScenePut | SceneAnswer |
| DELETE `/api/v1/scenes/{id}` | none | ScenesResponse |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/brightness` | GroupBrightnessPut | Scene |
| POST `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/move` | GroupMove | GroupMoved |
| PATCH `/api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/props` | Props | Scene |
| PUT `/api/v1/scenes/active` | SceneActivePut | ScenesResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Moves or copies one group between two scenes in one save.

```json
{
  "to": "scene:other",
  "copy": true,
  "expected_rev_from": 4,
  "expected_rev_to": 1
}
```

## Group properties

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/scenes-id-groups-group-props.md

# Group properties

Method and path: PATCH /api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/props.

Area: Scenes and chains.

## Request

**PATCH /api/v1/scenes/{id}/groups/{group}/props**

Changes the property values of one group's effect.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>/groups/<group>/props"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/scenes/<id>/groups/<group>/props", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"speed":{"type":"number","value":30}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `Props`.

A map of property id to PropValue.

**Answer body**: `Scene`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the scene. |
| `name` | `string` | The name of the scene. |
| `rev` | `number` | The revision of the scene; it moves with every saved change. |
| `groups` | `array of Group` | The groups the scene holds. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the scene that holds the group. |
| `group` | `string` | The id of a group in the scene named by the `id` path parameter. Any scene, active or not. |

## Audio source

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/audio-source.md

# Audio source

Method and path: PUT /api/v1/audio/source.

Area: Audio.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/audio/source**

Chooses the audio source.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"kind":"follow_default"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/source"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/source", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"kind":"follow_default"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `AudioSource`.

One of: "follow_default", "endpoint".

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"follow_default" or "endpoint"` | The kind of source to use: `follow_default` follows the system pick, `endpoint` names a device. |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the endpoint to use. Optional. |
| `flow` | `AudioFlow` | Whether the endpoint is an input or an output. Optional. |
| `name_hint` | `string` | A label to show for the chosen endpoint. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `ResolvedAudioSource`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `requested` | `AudioSource` | The audio source that was picked. |
| `endpoint_id` | `string or null` | The endpoint the capture opened or will open; null when there is no endpoint at all. |
| `name` | `string or null` | The name of the endpoint. |
| `flow` | `AudioFlow or null` | Whether the endpoint is an input or an output. |
| `fallback` | `AudioFallback or null` | Why the capture is not on the picked endpoint. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PUT `/api/v1/audio/source` | AudioSource | ResolvedAudioSource |
| GET `/api/v1/audio/sources` | none | AudioSources |
| GET `/api/v1/audio/test` | none | AudioTestState |
| PUT `/api/v1/audio/test` | AudioTestRequest | AudioTestLease |
| DELETE `/api/v1/audio/test` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**PUT**

Chooses the audio source.

```json
{
  "kind": "follow_default"
}
```

## Audio test

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/audio-test.md

# Audio test

Method and path: GET / PUT / DELETE /api/v1/audio/test.

Area: Audio.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/audio/test**

Reads and renews an audio test lease with the id the PUT returned; an unknown or expired lease answers 410.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test?lease=<lease_id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test?lease=<lease_id>", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/audio/test**

Tests an audio endpoint and issues a lease. Set listen true for an input so the microphone opens, or leave it false to test an output; every PUT issues a lease.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"listen":false}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"listen":false}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/audio/test**

Ends the audio test lease with the id the PUT returned.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test?lease=<lease_id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/audio/test?lease=<lease_id>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `AudioTestState`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `AudioTestStatus` | The state of the audio test. |
| `source` | `ResolvedAudioSource` | The audio source the test is using. |
| `sample_rate` | `number or null` | The sample rate the capture reports, in hertz. |
| `channels` | `number or null` | The channel count the capture reports. |
| `bits_per_sample` | `number or null` | The bit depth the capture device reports. |
| `format_tag` | `number or null` | The audio format the capture device reports. |
| `peak` | `number or null` | The peak level the capture meter reports, from 0 to 1, before the endpoint's own volume. |
| `peak_db` | `number or null` | The peak level in dBFS, floored at the silence floor. |
| `bands` | `array of number` | The bands the effects read, from 0 to 1. Empty when nothing is captured. |
| `packets` | `integer` | How many packets arrived in the last interval. |
| `silent_packets` | `integer` | How many of those packets were silent. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lease` | `string` | The lease_id returned by the audio test PUT. Paste that value into the URL. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `AudioTestRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listen` | `boolean` | Listen to the picked input. An output is tested without it; an input needs it. Leaving it out means false. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `AudioTestLease`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lease_id` | `string` | The id returned when the test lease started. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the lease was released.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the lease was released. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lease` | `string` | The lease_id returned by the audio test PUT. Paste that value into the URL. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PUT `/api/v1/audio/source` | AudioSource | ResolvedAudioSource |
| GET `/api/v1/audio/sources` | none | AudioSources |
| GET `/api/v1/audio/test` | none | AudioTestState |
| PUT `/api/v1/audio/test` | AudioTestRequest | AudioTestLease |
| DELETE `/api/v1/audio/test` | none | JSON object |

## Example

**GET**

Reads and renews an audio test lease with the id the PUT returned; an unknown or expired lease answers 410.

This route takes no request body.

**PUT**

Tests an audio endpoint and issues a lease. Set listen true for an input so the microphone opens, or leave it false to test an output; every PUT issues a lease.

```json
{
  "listen": false
}
```

**DELETE**

Ends the audio test lease with the id the PUT returned.

This route takes no request body.

## Preview

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/preview.md

# Preview

Method and path: GET /api/v1/preview.

Area: Preview.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/preview**

Streams the whole rendered picture. Each binary frame holds a 16-bit little-endian width, a 16-bit little-endian height, then width times height RGB triples. With stack=true it streams the stack preview; without it, the running effect.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl "ws://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/preview?token=$TOKEN&stack=true"
# Needs a curl built with WebSocket support (7.86 or later); the JavaScript sample is the main example.
```

```js
const token = process.env.CANVAS_RGB_TOKEN;
const socket = new WebSocket("ws://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/preview?token=" + encodeURIComponent(token) + "&stack=true");
socket.binaryType = "arraybuffer";
socket.onmessage = (event) => {
  console.log(new Uint8Array(event.data));
};
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `WebSocket (binary frames)`.

No field list is published for this body.

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | `string` | The API token, in the query string because a browser cannot set a header on a WebSocket handshake. |
| `stack` | `boolean` | True streams the stack preview engine. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/preview` | none | WebSocket (binary frames) |
| GET `/api/v1/preview/group` | none | WebSocket (binary frames) |
| GET `/api/v1/preview/lights` | none | WebSocket (binary frames) |

## Example

**GET**

Streams the whole rendered picture. Each binary frame holds a 16-bit little-endian width, a 16-bit little-endian height, then width times height RGB triples. With stack=true it streams the stack preview; without it, the running effect.

This route takes no request body.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
```

| DELETE `/api/v1/displays/{id}` | none | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/displays/{id}/value` | SetDisplayValue | SetDisplayValue |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals` | none | PeripheralsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | none | PeripheralDetail |
| PATCH `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | Props | Props |
| PUT `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/access` | PeripheralAccess | PeripheralAccess |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/read` | none | ReadProgress |

## Example

**GET**

Lists the numeric displays with their settings and current values.

This route takes no request body.

## Display

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/displays-id.md

# Display

Method and path: PUT / DELETE /api/v1/displays/{id}.

Area: Displays and peripherals.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/displays/{id}**

Changes the settings of one display.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"device":"display:2b1c:3d4e","source":{"kind":"api"},"unit":"celsius","decimals":0,"blink_above":80}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/displays/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/displays/<id>", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"device":"display:2b1c:3d4e","source":{"kind":"api"},"unit":"celsius","decimals":0,"blink_above":80}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**DELETE /api/v1/displays/{id}**

Removes one display's saved config and closes the device.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/displays/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/displays/<id>", {
  method: "DELETE",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `DisplayConfig`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `DeviceId` | The display the config belongs to. |
| `source` | `DisplaySource` | Where the display's number comes from. |
| `unit` | `DisplayUnit` | The unit the number is shown in: `celsius` or `fahrenheit`. |
| `decimals` | `number` | How many digits follow the decimal point. |
| `blink_above` | `number or null` | The value at or above which the display blinks; null leaves it steady. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `DisplayConfig`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `device` | `DeviceId` | The display the config belongs to. |
| `source` | `DisplaySource` | Where the display's number comes from. |
| `unit` | `DisplayUnit` | The unit the number is shown in: `celsius` or `fahrenheit`. |
| `decimals` | `number` | How many digits follow the decimal point. |
| `blink_above` | `number or null` | The value at or above which the display blinks; null leaves it steady. |

**DELETE**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the display whose config was removed.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the saved config was removed. |
| `device_id` | `string` | The display whose config was removed. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the display to change. |

## Peripheral

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/peripherals-id.md

# Peripheral

Method and path: GET / PATCH /api/v1/peripherals/{id}.

Area: Displays and peripherals.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/peripherals/{id}**

Reports one peripheral's schema and last-read values; ?fresh=true reads the device now.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>?fresh=true"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>?fresh=true", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PATCH /api/v1/peripherals/{id}**

Changes one peripheral's settings.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"brightness":{"type":"number","value":30}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>", {
  method: "PATCH",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"brightness":{"type":"number","value":30}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `PeripheralDetail`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `info` | `PeripheralInfo` | The peripheral itself. |
| `schema` | `PeripheralSchema` | The peripheral's sections and properties. |
| `values` | `an object keyed by text, with PropValue values` | The values read from the device, by property key. A key the device did not report this time is absent; all of them are absent while reads are off. |
| `access` | `PeripheralAccess` | What the daemon may do with this device. |
| `problem` | `string or null` | Why the values are missing, when they are: reads are off, the device did not answer or the vendor app holds it. It is null after a good read. |
| `read_at_ms` | `integer` | When the values were last read from the device, in Unix milliseconds. The daemon answers from kept values, so the editor shows how old they are. Optional. |

| Query | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fresh` | `boolean` | True reads the device now. Without it the values are the ones the daemon kept from the last read. |

**PATCH**

**Request body**: `Props`.

A map of property id to PropValue.

**Answer body**: `Props`.

A map of property id to PropValue.

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the peripheral the route names. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/displays` | none | array of DisplayStatus |
| PUT `/api/v1/displays/{id}` | DisplayConfig | DisplayConfig |
| DELETE `/api/v1/displays/{id}` | none | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/displays/{id}/value` | SetDisplayValue | SetDisplayValue |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals` | none | PeripheralsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | none | PeripheralDetail |
| PATCH `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | Props | Props |
| PUT `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/access` | PeripheralAccess | PeripheralAccess |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/read` | none | ReadProgress |

## Example

**GET**

Reports one peripheral's schema and last-read values; ?fresh=true reads the device now.

This route takes no request body.

**PATCH**

Changes one peripheral's settings.

```json
{
  "brightness": {
    "type": "number",
    "value": 30
  }
}
```

## Peripheral access

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/peripherals-id-access.md

# Peripheral access

Method and path: PUT /api/v1/peripherals/{id}/access.

Area: Displays and peripherals.

## Request

**PUT /api/v1/peripherals/{id}/access**

Turns reads and configuration writes on or off for one peripheral. `writes` without `reads` answers 422, because a write patches what the device last reported.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"reads":true,"writes":true}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>/access"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/peripherals/<id>/access", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"reads":true,"writes":true}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**PUT**

**Request body**: `PeripheralAccess`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reads` | `boolean` | True opens the device and reads its settings. A read may send the device a request that changes no setting. |
| `writes` | `boolean` | True sends config writes. It needs reads, because a write patches what the device last reported; `writes` without `reads` answers 422. |

**Answer body**: `PeripheralAccess`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reads` | `boolean` | True opens the device and reads its settings. A read may send the device a request that changes no setting. |
| `writes` | `boolean` | True sends config writes. It needs reads, because a write patches what the device last reported; `writes` without `reads` answers 422. |

| Path | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | The id of the peripheral to open or close. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/displays` | none | array of DisplayStatus |
| PUT `/api/v1/displays/{id}` | DisplayConfig | DisplayConfig |
| DELETE `/api/v1/displays/{id}` | none | JSON object |
| PUT `/api/v1/displays/{id}/value` | SetDisplayValue | SetDisplayValue |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals` | none | PeripheralsResponse |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | none | PeripheralDetail |
| PATCH `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}` | Props | Props |
| PUT `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/access` | PeripheralAccess | PeripheralAccess |
| GET `/api/v1/peripherals/{id}/read` | none | ReadProgress |

## Example

**PUT**

Turns reads and configuration writes on or off for one peripheral. `writes` without `reads` answers 422, because a write patches what the device last reported.

```json
{
  "reads": true,
  "writes": true
}
```

## Config export

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/config-export.md

# Config export

Method and path: GET /api/v1/config/export.

Area: Settings and update.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/config/export**

Exports the configuration as one JSON bundle.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/config/export"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/config/export", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `ExportBundle`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `number` | The format version of the saved file. |
| `exported_at` | `string` | The time the bundle was exported. |
| `app_version` | `string` | The version of the build that wrote the bundle. |
| `settings` | `Settings` | The saved application settings. |
| `layouts` | `LayoutsFile` | The saved layouts in the bundle. |
| `zones` | `ZonesFile` | The saved LED counts in the bundle. |
| `effects` | `EffectsFile` | The saved effects in the bundle. |
| `fans` | `FansFile` | The saved fan settings in the bundle. |
| `displays` | `array of DisplayConfig` | The numeric displays' configs. They are absent in bundles from before displays, and import then replaces the saved display configs with these, like the other files. |
| `stacks` | `array of Stack` | The saved effect stacks. They are absent in bundles from before stacks, and import then replaces the saved stacks with these, like the other files. |
| `lights` | `LightsFile` | The saved lights. They are absent in older bundles, and import then migrates their layouts. Optional. |
| `scenes` | `ScenesFile` | The saved scenes. They are absent in older bundles, as the lights are. Optional. |
| `patterns` | `array of Pattern` | The saved patterns. They are absent in older bundles. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |

| POST `/api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel` | none | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/onboarding/complete` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/settings` | none | Settings |
| PUT `/api/v1/settings` | Settings | Settings |
| POST `/api/v1/update/install` | InstallUpdateRequest | InstallUpdateResponse |

This route takes no request body.

## Config import

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/config-import.md

# Config import

Method and path: POST /api/v1/config/import.

Area: Settings and update.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/config/import**

Validates and imports a configuration bundle. The bundle replaces every saved setting, scene, light, fan, display, stack and pattern with the one it carries, so export the current configuration first.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"schema_version":1,"exported_at":"2026-11-21T12:00:00Z","app_version":"0.18.1","settings":{"fps":30,"black_on_lock":false,"on_quit":"black","boot_color":"#1b2c3d","brightness":80,"power":"running","warmth":6500},"layouts":{"schema_version":1,"active":"","layouts":[]},"zones":{"schema_version":1,"sizes":{}},"effects":{"schema_version":1,"saved":{},"presets":{},"favorites":[]},"fans":{"schema_version":1,"floor_percent":20,"active_profile":"Default","profiles":[{"name":"Default","headers":{}}],"boot_color":"#1b2c3d","hot_limits":{"cpu_c":null,"gpu_c":null,"board_c":null}},"displays":[{"device":"display:5f6a:7b8c","source":{"kind":"api"},"unit":"celsius","decimals":0,"blink_above":null}],"stacks":[{"id":"stack:example","layers":[]},{"id":"stack:other","layers":[]}],"patterns":[{"id":"pattern:Example","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#d21e28","#0f9d58","#1a73e8","#fbbc04"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}},{"id":"pattern:Other","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#101010","#202020","#303030","#404040"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}}],"lights":{"schema_version":1,"chains":[],"lights":[{"id":"openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0","device_id":"openrgb:2a3b4c5d","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false},{"id":"openrgb:6e7f8091#z0","device_id":"openrgb:6e7f8091","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false},{"id":"openrgb:HID:VID_3151&PID_4015#z0","device_id":"openrgb:HID:VID_3151&PID_4015","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false,"name":"Old keyboard lights"}]},"scenes":{"schema_version":1,"active":"everything","scenes":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","rev":1,"groups":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","members":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"plays":{"type":"effect","effect":"solid","props":{}},"mode":"flow_across","brightness":100}]},{"id":"scene:other","name":"Other","rev":1,"groups":[]},{"id":"scene:retired","name":"Retired","rev":1,"groups":[]}]}}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/config/import"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/config/import", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"schema_version":1,"exported_at":"2026-11-21T12:00:00Z","app_version":"0.18.1","settings":{"fps":30,"black_on_lock":false,"on_quit":"black","boot_color":"#1b2c3d","brightness":80,"power":"running","warmth":6500},"layouts":{"schema_version":1,"active":"","layouts":[]},"zones":{"schema_version":1,"sizes":{}},"effects":{"schema_version":1,"saved":{},"presets":{},"favorites":[]},"fans":{"schema_version":1,"floor_percent":20,"active_profile":"Default","profiles":[{"name":"Default","headers":{}}],"boot_color":"#1b2c3d","hot_limits":{"cpu_c":null,"gpu_c":null,"board_c":null}},"displays":[{"device":"display:5f6a:7b8c","source":{"kind":"api"},"unit":"celsius","decimals":0,"blink_above":null}],"stacks":[{"id":"stack:example","layers":[]},{"id":"stack:other","layers":[]}],"patterns":[{"id":"pattern:Example","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#d21e28","#0f9d58","#1a73e8","#fbbc04"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}},{"id":"pattern:Other","built_on":{"led_count":4,"arrangement":"ring"},"frames":[{"colors":["#101010","#202020","#303030","#404040"],"hold":0}],"motion":{"type":"none"}}],"lights":{"schema_version":1,"chains":[],"lights":[{"id":"openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0","device_id":"openrgb:2a3b4c5d","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false},{"id":"openrgb:6e7f8091#z0","device_id":"openrgb:6e7f8091","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false},{"id":"openrgb:HID:VID_3151&PID_4015#z0","device_id":"openrgb:HID:VID_3151&PID_4015","zone_index":0,"arrangement":"strip","reversed":false,"name":"Old keyboard lights"}]},"scenes":{"schema_version":1,"active":"everything","scenes":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","rev":1,"groups":[{"id":"everything","name":"Everything","members":["openrgb:2a3b4c5d#z0"],"plays":{"type":"effect","effect":"solid","props":{}},"mode":"flow_across","brightness":100}]},{"id":"scene:other","name":"Other","rev":1,"groups":[]},{"id":"scene:retired","name":"Retired","rev":1,"groups":[]}]}}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `ExportBundle`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schema_version` | `number` | The format version of the saved file. |
| `exported_at` | `string` | The time the bundle was exported. |
| `app_version` | `string` | The version of the build that wrote the bundle. |
| `settings` | `Settings` | The saved application settings. |
| `layouts` | `LayoutsFile` | The saved layouts in the bundle. |
| `zones` | `ZonesFile` | The saved LED counts in the bundle. |
| `effects` | `EffectsFile` | The saved effects in the bundle. |
| `fans` | `FansFile` | The saved fan settings in the bundle. |
| `displays` | `array of DisplayConfig` | The numeric displays' configs. They are absent in bundles from before displays, and import then replaces the saved display configs with these, like the other files. Optional. |
| `stacks` | `array of Stack` | The saved effect stacks. They are absent in bundles from before stacks, and import then replaces the saved stacks with these, like the other files. Optional. |
| `lights` | `LightsFile` | The saved lights. They are absent in older bundles, and import then migrates their layouts. Optional. |
| `scenes` | `ScenesFile` | The saved scenes. They are absent in older bundles, as the lights are. Optional. |
| `patterns` | `array of Pattern` | The saved patterns. They are absent in older bundles. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the bundle was imported.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the bundle was imported. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/config/export` | none | ExportBundle |
| POST `/api/v1/config/import` | ExportBundle | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel` | none | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/onboarding/complete` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/settings` | none | Settings |
| PUT `/api/v1/settings` | Settings | Settings |
| POST `/api/v1/update/install` | InstallUpdateRequest | InstallUpdateResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Validates and imports a configuration bundle. The bundle replaces every saved setting, scene, light, fan, display, stack and pattern with the one it carries, so export the current configuration first.

```json
{
  "schema_version": 1,
  "exported_at": "2026-11-21T12:00:00Z",
  "app_version": "0.18.1",
  "settings": {
    "fps": 30,
    "black_on_lock": false,
    "on_quit": "black",
    "boot_color": "#1b2c3d",
    "brightness": 80,
    "power": "running",
    "warmth": 6500
  },
  "layouts": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "active": "",
    "layouts": []
  },
  "zones": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "sizes": {}
  },
  "effects": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "saved": {},
    "presets": {},
    "favorites": []
  },
  "fans": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "floor_percent": 20,
    "active_profile": "Default",
    "profiles": [
      {
        "name": "Default",
        "headers": {}
      }
    ],
    "boot_color": "#1b2c3d",
    "hot_limits": {

      "gpu_c": null,
      "board_c": null
    }

      "source": {

    }
  ],

    },
    {

      "layers": []
    }
  ],

            "#fbbc04"

        "type": "none"
```

## Dismiss zone panel

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/first-run-dismiss-zone-panel.md

# Dismiss zone panel

Method and path: POST /api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel.

Area: Settings and update.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel**

Dismisses the first-run prompt to size the ARGB headers.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the panel was dismissed.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the panel was dismissed. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |

| PUT `/api/v1/settings` | Settings | Settings |
| POST `/api/v1/update/install` | InstallUpdateRequest | InstallUpdateResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Dismisses the first-run prompt to size the ARGB headers.

This route takes no request body.

## Settings

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/settings.md

# Settings

Method and path: GET / PUT /api/v1/settings.

Area: Settings and update.

## Request

**GET /api/v1/settings**

Returns the current settings.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X GET -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/settings"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/settings", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
  },
});
const data = await response.json();
```

**PUT /api/v1/settings**

Replaces the settings.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"fps":30,"black_on_lock":false,"on_quit":"black","boot_color":"#1b2c3d","brightness":80,"power":"running","warmth":6500}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/settings"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/settings", {
  method: "PUT",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"fps":30,"black_on_lock":false,"on_quit":"black","boot_color":"#1b2c3d","brightness":80,"power":"running","warmth":6500}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**GET**

**Request body**: `none`.

No field list is published for this body.

**Answer body**: `Settings`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fps` | `number` | The frame rate target, from 10 to 60. |
| `black_on_lock` | `boolean` | True turns the lights off while the screen is locked. It is off by default. |
| `on_quit` | `OnQuit` | The lighting to leave on at exit: `black` or `leave_last_frame`. |
| `boot_color` | `Rgb8 or null` | The colour shown before the daemon connects, as a hex string such as #1b2c3d; null means black. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `warmth` | `number` | The colour temperature in kelvin, from 1800 to 6500; 6500 leaves the picture unchanged. |

**PUT**

**Request body**: `Settings`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fps` | `number` | The frame rate target, from 10 to 60. |
| `black_on_lock` | `boolean` | True turns the lights off while the screen is locked. It is off by default. |
| `on_quit` | `OnQuit` | The lighting to leave on at exit: `black` or `leave_last_frame`. |
| `boot_color` | `Rgb8 or null` | The colour shown before the daemon connects, as a hex string such as #1b2c3d; null means black. Optional. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `warmth` | `number` | The colour temperature in kelvin, from 1800 to 6500; 6500 leaves the picture unchanged. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `Settings`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fps` | `number` | The frame rate target, from 10 to 60. |
| `black_on_lock` | `boolean` | True turns the lights off while the screen is locked. It is off by default. |
| `on_quit` | `OnQuit` | The lighting to leave on at exit: `black` or `leave_last_frame`. |
| `boot_color` | `Rgb8 or null` | The colour shown before the daemon connects, as a hex string such as #1b2c3d; null means black. |
| `brightness` | `number` | The brightness of the output, from 0 to 100. |
| `power` | `Power` | Whether the render loop runs or pauses. |
| `warmth` | `number` | The colour temperature in kelvin, from 1800 to 6500; 6500 leaves the picture unchanged. |

## Install update

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/update-install.md

# Install update

Method and path: POST /api/v1/update/install.

Area: Settings and update.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/update/install**

Installs a signed update package.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"installer":"D:\\Downloads\\canvas-rgb-0.18.1-setup.exe","signature":"untrusted comment: minisign signature\nRWQf6X8s1m4n3p2q1r0s7t6u5v4w3x2y1z0a9b8c7d6e5f4g3h2j1k0l9m8n7p6q5r4s3t2u1"}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/update/install"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/update/install", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"installer":"D:\\Downloads\\canvas-rgb-0.18.1-setup.exe","signature":"untrusted comment: minisign signature\nRWQf6X8s1m4n3p2q1r0s7t6u5v4w3x2y1z0a9b8c7d6e5f4g3h2j1k0l9m8n7p6q5r4s3t2u1"}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `InstallUpdateRequest`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `installer` | `string` | The absolute path of the installer, readable by the calling user. |
| `signature` | `string` | The text of the installer's signature file. |

**Answer body**: `InstallUpdateResponse`.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `string` | The signed version the update service started installing. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET `/api/v1/config/export` | none | ExportBundle |
| POST `/api/v1/config/import` | ExportBundle | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/first-run/dismiss-zone-panel` | none | JSON object |
| POST `/api/v1/onboarding/complete` | none | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/settings` | none | Settings |
| PUT `/api/v1/settings` | Settings | Settings |
| POST `/api/v1/update/install` | InstallUpdateRequest | InstallUpdateResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Installs a signed update package.

```json
{
  "installer": "D:\\Downloads\\canvas-rgb-0.18.1-setup.exe",
  "signature": "untrusted comment: minisign signature\nRWQf6X8s1m4n3p2q1r0s7t6u5v4w3x2y1z0a9b8c7d6e5f4g3h2j1k0l9m8n7p6q5r4s3t2u1"
}
```

## Fail sensor

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/api/diag-fail-sensor.md

# Fail sensor

Method and path: POST /api/v1/diag/fail-sensor.

Area: Diagnostics.

## Request

**POST /api/v1/diag/fail-sensor**

Makes a temperature source report a failure, for a safety test. The source is `cpu`, `gpu` or `board:<name>`; any other value answers 422.

```sh
# Check who owns port 9430 first; see the Verify the listener before you send the token section of the getting-started page
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"source":"cpu","failed":true}' "http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/diag/fail-sensor"
```

```js
const response = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:9430/api/v1/diag/fail-sensor", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({"source":"cpu","failed":true}),
});
const data = await response.json();
```

## Types

**POST**

**Request body**: `FailSensorRequest`.

The temperature source to mark as failed and whether to mark it.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` | The temperature source to change: `cpu`, `gpu` or `board:<name>`. |
| `failed` | `boolean` | True marks the source as failed. Optional. |

**Answer body**: `JSON object`.

The fields the daemon sends: the temperature source that was told to fail and whether it now reports a failure.

| Field | Type | What it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True when the failure flag was applied. |
| `source` | `JSON object` | The temperature source told to fail. |
| `failed` | `boolean` | True when the source now reports a failure. |

## Route index

| Method / path | Body | Answer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST `/api/v1/diag/fail-sensor` | FailSensorRequest | JSON object |
| GET `/api/v1/diag/readback` | none | ReadbackResponse |

## Example

**POST**

Makes a temperature source report a failure, for a safety test. The source is `cpu`, `gpu` or `board:<name>`; any other value answers 422.

```json
{
  "source": "cpu",
  "failed": true
}
```

## CLI reference

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/cli.md

# CLI reference

The command is `canvas-rgb`. Install puts it on the PATH.
Most commands talk to the daemon over the local API. The client checks who holds port 9430 before it reads the token file or sends anything. Three commands work without a daemon: `effects check`, `diag dump-frames` and `diag bundle`.

## Global flags

| Flag | VALUE | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | `—` | Print the answer as JSON. Honoured by every command except config export, diag dump-frames and diag bundle. |
| `--api <URL>` | `<url>` | The API base URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9430. Also read from CANVAS_RGB_API. |
| `-h, --help` | `—` | Print help. No daemon needed. |
| `-V, --version` | `—` | Print the version. |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | The command succeeded. |
| 1 | The API refused the request, or a local check failed, such as a file that cannot be read or parsed. |
| 2 | The API port has no listener, its listener is outside the client's trusted programs, or the daemon went past its request limit. The client withholds the token in the first two cases. In the last case the request may have reached the daemon. |

## JSON output

With `--json`, `status` prints the raw status object. `effects list`, `diag readback` and `peripherals show` print the API's answer unchanged. `effects check` prints one report document with the name, properties, frame times and tile scores. `effects source` prints the API answer unchanged, or with `--out` a document with `id`, `file_name`, `out` and `bytes`. `effects preset list` builds its own document with `effect`, `presets` and `user_presets`. The write commands wrap the answer in one document: `scenes create` and `scenes edit` print `saved`, `run` and `scene`; `scenes delete` prints `saved`, `run` and `deleted`; `effects import` prints `saved`, `run`, `effect` and `replaced`; `effects delete` prints `saved`, `run`, `deleted` and `presets_removed`; `effects preset save` prints `saved`, `run`, `effect`, `preset` and `user_presets`; `effects preset delete` prints `saved`, `run` and `deleted`, with the effect and preset as the fields of `deleted`. `config export`, `diag dump-frames` and `diag bundle` ignore `--json`: they write their files and print their own text.
With `--json`, a failed `scenes create`, `scenes edit`, `scenes delete`, `effects import`, `effects check`, `effects source`, `effects delete`, `effects preset list`, `effects preset save` or `effects preset delete` prints one document on stdout: `{"saved": false, "run": <run or null>, "error": "<text>"}`. `run` is null for `effects check`, `effects source` and `effects preset list`. With `--json`, other commands print the API's error body on stdout when there is one. Without `--json`, no command writes a failure document or an error body to stdout. Every failed command also prints a line on stderr.

## Read daemon status

Source: https://iamchumby.github.io/canvas-rgb/docs/cli/status.md

# Read daemon status

## Syntax

```sh
canvas-rgb status
```

Prints the daemon's status: version, power, brightness, frame rate and the scene playing. With `--json`, the answer is the raw status object.

## Flags

No command-specific flags. Global flags still apply.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | The command succeeded. |
| 1 | The API refused the request, or a local check failed. |
| 2 | The API port has no listener, its listener is outside the client's trusted programs, or the daemon went past its request limit. |

## Global flags

| Flag | VALUE | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | `—` | Print the answer as JSON. Honoured by every command except config export, diag dump-frames and diag bundle. |
| `--api <URL>` | `<url>` | The API base URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:9430. Also read from CANVAS_RGB_API. |
| `-h, --help` | `—` | Print help. No daemon needed. |
| `-V, --version` | `—` | Print the version. |
